reviews.text: Our inspector flagged the Federal Pacific panel in our Clintonville house. They drew the whole line from the meter to the outlets on one sheet, swapped the panel in a day, and labeled every breaker in plain words.
reviews.name: Grace H.

reviews.text: We wanted an EV charger and assumed we'd need a new service. The load check said our 200-amp panel had room. The charger went in on a 40-amp circuit, permit and all, in one afternoon.
reviews.name: Owen B.

reviews.text: Every outlet upstairs was two-prong. They explained the three options, ran grounds where the walls allowed and used GFCI protection where they didn't. Each outlet has a clear label now.
reviews.name: Lena K.

reviews.text: Kitchen lights flickered whenever the fridge kicked on. It turned out to be a loose neutral in the panel. Found and fixed in under an hour, and they showed me the burned lug.
reviews.name: Sam T.

reviews.text: The heat pump installers needed a new circuit and disconnect before they could start. Lineside came out two days later and had it ready for them. Good coordination with the HVAC crew.
reviews.name: Beth R.

reviews.text: The surge protector went in fine, but scheduling took longer than I expected because of a permit backlog. They kept me updated by text the whole time.
reviews.name: Carl M.
